parameters.name: rail selector positions
parameters.condition: as printed on the module body

quantities_taught.child_facing_meaning: whether the path from one end to the other is joined up

behaviour.child_level: The module sits between the source and the board, and nothing moves through it until an adult connects it.
behaviour.adult_level: With no source attached the module is an unenergised passive assembly; the selector position determines nothing until an input is present, and no rail can be characterised by inspection alone.
behaviour.simplification_check: The child version omits regulation entirely, which is honest here because nothing is regulated while nothing is connected.

failure_modes.wrong_action: connecting the source before an adult has checked the selector
failure_modes.consequence: a rail at a value nobody verified reaches the board
failure_modes.prevented_by: the source stays disconnected for the whole of this unit

evidence_card.prompt: Trace the path with your finger and tick each place you reach.

_fixture: A unit citing a supply that is not a verified_official permitted input of this kit. An unverified input must be sourced and photographed before a unit may use it.
